snippet.title: Principia Level Showcase - Puzzle Adventure 1-4 by Dinosaurismus
snippet.description:
Playing through a set of four puzzle levels in the Puzzle Adventure level series by Dinosaurismus. We start off by building a car with a emitter gun attached to it, then in the second one we solve a laser puzzle to keep a beam active while guiding robots to the goal. The third one is a simple Apparatus-style marble maze, and the fourth one is a simple circuitry puzzle.

The levels are all rather short in length and simple, so the video shows every level from 1 to 4.

Levels:
1. https://principia-web.se/archive/level/2138
2. https://principia-web.se/archive/level/2610
3. https://principia-web.se/archive/level/3113
4. https://principia-web.se/archive/level/4481

Principia is a free and open source physics-based sandbox game featuring mechanics, electronics, robots, puzzles, Lua scripting and more. You can read more about the game and download it for the supported platforms at: https://principia-web.se/
